name: Marker Underline Sweep
easing: text fade: EASE.out f0-10; underline 1 EASE.out f14-30; underline 2 EASE.out f30-42
bestFor: Emphasizing one key phrase inside a sentence ('real failures').
notSuitable: Long sentences (>34 chars) or more than one emphasized phrase.
keyframeTable: line of text 80% opaque, 4px low, all cream
text settled; keyword turned orange; underline 1 starts at left of keyword
underline 1 complete, underline 2 (thin, shorter, 22px lower) 50% drawn
rest: both strokes complete under the keyword
script: f0-10: sentence fades in and rises 20px.
f14: keyword switches from cream to orange.
f14-30: thick orange marker stroke sweeps left→right under the keyword.
f30-42: thinner second stroke draws underneath, slightly shorter (the double underline).
colorRules: Keyword + both strokes orange; everything else cream.
